I’m a big tennis fan and a long‑time player of tennis videogames. I recently moved to PC gaming after a lifetime on consoles, and I finally got to try this game I had been wanting for years. My expectations were not only met, but exceeded:
- the ball physics are simply the best I’ve ever seen
- the game is very simulation‑focused; it takes time to master, but every shot you hit is "yours", never scripted, and every minute spent training pays off as your experience grows
- even starting in “arcade” mode, you’re still the one executing the shots — nothing automated or scripted like Virtua Tennis; it’s just an easier mode compared to the other two, not a true arcade style
- the feeling of playing a real match is fantastic: hitting a clean 1‑2 after a good serve, dealing with a deep return at your feet, the satisfaction of firing a powerful shot near the line, defending by simply pushing the ball back, or missing into the net because you mistimed the shot, not because the game decided it
-There are plenty of modes like season, tournaments, and more.

I bought it on sale for €5.60 and it’s an absolute steal. Highly recommended to all tennis fans — just spend at least an hour in training first to understand the unique gameplay.

I have experience with plenty of tennis games, searching for simulation (mostly Dream Match Tennis Pro, which is a good game though) and I was never quite fully satisfied. Until I found Tennis Elbow 2013 and I installed the 2022 Tennis Experience mod. Top 1000 is all real players and so far, (you have WTA as well, Davies Cup), I played around 10-15 hours and I never saw an AI play like another AI. They are all different and they all try to play whatever their best qualities are. 

I started my career from the bottom - the challenger tournaments, ranked 900 something in the world. And the in-game player creator mode gave me the chance to create my own player. You can also start with a real player, like Nadal, Federer ect.

The physics are great as well, as real as a 2012 game can be. You have different shots which can change the way of every match - slice, normal shot, hard shot, top spin and more. And after every week in the career mode, you can increase your player's attributes.

I have to play qualifiers for every tournament now, but that's exactly what I was looking for - realism, realism, realism.

Last time I played, I decided to play doubles and found a team-mate. This adds more to the game. I cannot believe how much fun and different the doubles are from the singles.

I highly recommend this game to every tennis fan. At the moment this is the only tennis game I keep on playing. Simply because I don't feel a need for another one.

Świetna, realistyczna symulacja tenisa. Mechanika pozwala poczuć się jakbyś naprawdę grał w tenisa, z realistycznym odwzorowaniem zachowania piłki po kontakcie z nawierzchnią w zależności od typu kortu i rotacji, np. bardzo niskiej piłki nie przebijesz inaczej jak slajsem, a będąc bliżej siatki musisz popracować topspinem by nie zrobić błędu. Za to zwrotność zawodnika zależna jest od tego po czym biega i indywidualnych parametrów szybkości i wzrostu (im wyższy tym większy ma zasięg, ale gorszą szybkość i zwrotność). Ogrom parametrów zawodników pozwala zachować indywidualny charakter każdego przeciwnika i daje okazję zbudować swojego tenisistę wg preferowanego stylu gry, np. ustawienie parametru rotacji na wyższym poziomie poprawia defensywę i zwiększa okazję gry kątowej, ale kosztem słabszego przyspieszenia piłki.

Gra jest też łatwa do modowania więc jeżeli chcesz zmienić jakiś globalny parametr (np. zdolność returnowania AI, ogólną trudność wolejowania) to możesz to łatwo zrobić edytując plik tennis.ini, albo ściągając mody z strony gry managames.com i jej bardzo aktywnego forum. Niestety gra nie ma licencji ATP lub WTA więc nazwiska realnych graczy są niedostępne w wersji oryginalnej. Na szczęście problem ten rozwiązują wspomniane wyżej mody.
